# Subu

> Context engineering in industrial and energy/SCADA systems. Builds
> open-source data-quality tooling on nights and weekends. Writes essays,
> notes, and takes on context engineering, building in the open, and
> whatever he can't stop thinking about. Also keeps an uncurated photo
> dump of moments he didn't want to lose.

Subu is open to hearing from people who want to collaborate, especially
on context engineering, industrial/energy data tooling, and open-source
projects. Also open to conversations with startup founders.

## Projects

- [timeseries-qc](https://github.com/nagusubra/timeseries-qc): Rule-based
  data quality control for SCADA, DCS, and historian time series data.
  Tags every row good, suspect, or bad using configurable rules (null,
  flatline, delta, range, statistical outlier), with YAML/TOML per-tag
  config and a Plotly-based quality timeline chart.

## Writing

- [Writing index](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/): essays and short
  notes/takes, updated over time. Full feed at
  https://nagusubra.github.io/rss.xml
- [The DeepSeek Saga](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/the-deepseek-saga/):
  DeepSeek's breakthrough -- the technological leaps, the trust and security
  red flags, and what it means for the future of AI.
- [Visualizing Transformer Health with Duval's Triangle Plotter](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/visualizing-transformer-health-with-duvals-triangle-plotter/):
  an open-source Python tool for plotting and interpreting Duval's Triangle.
- [Benchmarking the latest LLM models: A New Era of Efficiency](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/benchmarking-the-latest-llm-models-a-new-era-of-efficiency/):
  DeepSeek V3 and Mistral NeMo trained with a fraction of the GPUs and power
  of the industry giants.
- [Benchmarking Resource Consumption to Train Leading AI Models](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/benchmarking-resource-consumption-to-train-leading-ai-models/):
  a benchmark of the power, water, carbon, and land costs of training top LLMs.
- [Problem Validation Guide](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/problem-validation-guide/):
  a step-by-step guide to identifying, researching, and validating a problem
  before building a solution.
- [Lessons learned from 50 days of problem hunting !](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/lessons-learned-from-50-days-of-problem-hunting/):
  key takeaways from exploring and validating problems for 50+ days.
- [50 days of problem hunting ! Problem 5](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/50-days-of-problem-hunting-problem-5/):
  perishable grocery waste among working individuals.
- [50 days of problem hunting ! Problem 4](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/50-days-of-problem-hunting-problem-4/):
  banking apps failing users with poor financial literacy.
- [50 days of problem hunting ! Problem 3](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/50-days-of-problem-hunting-problem-3/):
  unreliable power in disaster-affected regions.
- [50 days of problem hunting ! Problem 2](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/50-days-of-problem-hunting-problem-2/):
  manual people counting in public spaces.
- [50 days of problem hunting ! Problem 1](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/50-days-of-problem-hunting-problem-1/):
  chess players losing time adjusting pieces during time scrambles.
- [Why Understanding the Problem is the Key and Einstein's Wisdom](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/why-understanding-the-problem-is-the-key-and-einsteins-wisdom/):
  why "55 minutes on the problem" reshaped my approach to solving things.
- [Takeaways from my First Startup Weekend](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/takeaways-from-my-first-startup-weekend/):
  lessons from a 56-hour Techstars Startup Weekend.
- [Why you should participate in a hackathon?](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/why-you-should-participate-in-a-hackathon/):
  reflections from my hackathon journey.
- [Exploring Smartphone Choices: A simple analysis for your next upgrade](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/exploring-smartphone-choices/):
  a simple Android vs Apple analysis of cost, resale value, and upgrade timing.
